home.title: Current dataset
home.intro: What the app is looking at, and how to read it.

about.title: About the data
about.p1: Prices are collected from each shop on the dates shown. Every number on the site comes straight from that data; nothing is estimated or filled in.
about.p2: A shop that is only partly collected, or whose catalogue was imported as a one-off snapshot, is listed above with its status. Where a shop's regular prices can't be verified, its discounts are left out rather than shown wrong.
about.p3: A figure that would rest on too few products is left out, and the page says so in its place.

landing.compareNote: Which products both retailers carry, from the matched set; where a view can't be drawn yet, its layout and the reason.
landing.indexQuestion: How the basket's price moves against the base retailer, day by day.
landing.indexReason: Needs a second collected retailer and more than one collection day.
landing.gapQuestion: How far matched products' prices sit apart between two retailers.
landing.gapReason: Needs a second collected retailer with matched products.
landing.overlapQuestion: Which products both retailers carry, and which only one does.
landing.overlapReason: Needs a second collected retailer with matched products.
landing.intro: Each shop's own catalogue, and the two head to head on matched products.
landing.noRetailers: No collected retailer to report on.

assistant.title: Ryzan AI Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about prices, promotions, assortment and launches. Every number is quoted from the platform’s read-only data tools, with its data cutoff and source.

connect.title: Connect to enable
connect.body: Ryzan AI Assistant is not switched on yet. The owner has to turn on the AI model and its spending safeguards first. Until then no answers are generated, so nothing on this page is an AI answer.

samples.hint: Examples of what you will be able to ask once the assistant is connected.

q.coverage: How complete is the data for each retailer?
